name: openbb_economy_cpi
description:
Consumer price index for a country through the OpenBB Platform (obb.economy.cpi).
Returns: {country, data_points, cpi_data: [records with date, country and value]} or {country, error}.
Inputs (* required): country (lower case with underscores, e.g. united_states, japan; default united_states); provider (fred, imf or oecd; default fred, which needs a key; oecd and imf need none).
US-only alternatives: av_cpi, av_inflation, fred_cpi, fred_core_cpi. Keys: fmp, benzinga, fred, intrinio, polygon and tiingo need credentials in OpenBB's settings (~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json), not supplied by SAJHA; yfinance, oecd, federal_reserve, sec, imf and government_us need none.
Example: {"country": "japan", "provider": "oecd"}

provider.description: OpenBB data provider (fred, imf or oecd)
